_purpose: Build-side package overlay for the v1.1 rebuild (2026-11-06). build-manifest.json is owned by the orchestrator and still says package 1.0; the generators of the rebuilt artifacts (CCG, WTC, RSPEC, DD, SIR) read this file after the manifest and take package.version / issue_date and the Version Control change-log rows from it. why: Per-state validation pilot: oracle comparison + gap closures.

CCG: FED: pre-2020 Form W-4 filing-status mapping; business mileage rate split at 2026-07-01; tax-year 2027 indexation (Rev. Proc. 2026-35); US-Romania totalization agreement in force from 2026-09-01; leave, back pay, equity sourcing, garnishment and adjustment-procedure gaps closed
CA: DE 9C file formats, WARN threshold, SDI 2027 rate, HSA non-conformity, child-support fee, prevailing wage, agricultural overtime and UI coverage gaps closed
TX: UI report due dates, UI wage definition, new-hire contractors, jury and military leave; Labor Code 204.0025 enhanced wage-report fields stated as proposed only

NY: Method II per-period withholding tables (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly, daily and annual allowances and rate tables) for New York State and New York City, Method III rates and Yonkers tables added; quarterly and semiannual Method II payrolls stated as a documented limitation (no published table); PFL calendar-year accumulator; garnishment, paycard, pay statement, NYS-45, NYC flexible-benefit add-back and termination-notice gaps closed; Method II rounding convention left open
FL: reemployment tax XML 2026 changes and ch. 2026-52 in force
IL: statutory income tax rate, pay-statement content, UI separation notice, SSN display, Chicago tipped wage, Cook County paid leave rules, UI wage base 2027
PA: payment method, Philadelphia sick leave accrual, HSA withholding, local EIT base, state tax levy, certified payroll, support orders, minimum wage bill status, child labour
OH: payment timing, UI wage base not indexed, garnishment priority, certified payroll, no state PFML or TDI programme
NC: UI wage base derivation and registration, W-2 file format, other leave, separation notice, support-order payor duties, data breach, student-learner wage
MI: agricultural and domestic UI coverage, support-order remittance, 2026 PA 39 cited for the tips and overtime deduction (assessment level only)

GA: withholding split into two periods (Table E to 2026-05-10, current method from 2026-05-11); UI wage-report e-filing required for all employers from 2026-08-09; minimum wage exemptions and family-care leave status
WI: lodging and meal credit and tipped cash wage notes restored in the parameter table

CA: SDI employee rate 2027; IL: UI wage base 2027; GA: withholding standard deduction and dependent allowance split at 2026-05-11; MI: 2026 PA 39 cited
